dedupe_keys.name: d mimo factory hall cir dataset

description: An ETH Zürich team publishes simulated radio-channel data for distributed MIMO in an indoor factory hall. Zenodo provides public HDF5 channel-impulse-response and signal-strength files, MATLAB parsing examples and a README under CC BY 4.0. The documented ray-tracing setup uses Wireless InSite at 15 GHz, nine access points with 8 by 4 antenna arrays and grids of user equipment across several hall levels. AP-to-AP and AP-to-UE links include channel impulse responses; AP-to-UE links also have RSSI statistics. These data can benchmark industrial wireless coverage or communication-loss assumptions for smart-factory simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this hall scenario. A limitation is that ray-traced channels from one geometry are not measured propagation in all factories; moving machinery, people and interference may be absent. Recreating the simulation may require commercial Wireless InSite and the supplied 3D model. The HDF5 files were not downloaded, and no channel or capacity result was reproduced.
